assets.name: backgroundPrompt
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, production game background asset. Create one exquisitely polished original 2.5D illustrated background for a preschool touch game called Rain Garden. Wide landscape 16:9 composition, ideally 1920x1080. Warm handmade storybook gouache with subtle paper texture, soft rounded clay-like forms, excellent shape design, no outlines or only very soft brown outlines, sage green, butter yellow, warm cream, apricot, dusty turquoise. A small intimate garden viewed at a fixed gentle elevated angle, not a floating island: pale creamy sky with distant leafy silhouettes in the top 25%, a large soft round tree on the far left edge and a little wooden garden shelter tucked behind it. At left middle (25% width, 63% height) three clearly empty oval soil beds in grass for interactive flowers to be placed later. At right middle (72% width, 61% height) a small oval turquoise pond with a curved pale stone shore and broad clear water area. At middle bottom (48% width, 77% height) a blank warm cream picnic cloth on grass with a woven empty basket beside it. A winding pale path connects these three areas, abundant tasteful botanical details only along edges, small daisies and ferns. Leave broad open grass around and between areas for four animal sprites. Leave top left sky area clean for later title UI and bottom 12% relatively quiet for toolbar overlays. Soft ambient morning light, gentle contact shadows, sophisticated premium indie children game art. Important: environment only, no animals, no people, no faces, no cloud in foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep center open and interactions legible. The background will be used directly in a real Unity game, not a mockup screenshot.

assets.name: charactersPrompt
assets.prompt: Production game asset: one transparent PNG CHARACTER SPRITE ATLAS, square 2048 by 2048 if possible. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows in a regular equal grid, 16 separate full body character sprites. Each cell 512x512 conceptually, no sprite crosses its cell, generous transparent margin, feet aligned near bottom of each cell. Rows identity: row 1 ivory rabbit with two long leaf-shaped ears, a small sage-green neckerchief, peach cheeks; row 2 small honey-ochre hedgehog with soft rounded caramel quills and tiny moss-green satchel; row 3 butter-yellow duck with muted orange bill and sage leaf cap; row 4 small warm rust squirrel with large curved cinnamon tail and cream tummy. Columns pose: column 1 calm friendly standing front three-quarter pose; column 2 joyful open arms and smiling eyes, subtle jump; column 3 eyes closed sleepy/peaceful standing; column 4 curious leaning slightly sideways with bright surprised expression. Original cohesive mascots for a preschool garden game, very appealing premium hand-painted storybook art, softly textured gouache, velvety watercolor shading, not photorealistic, not plastic, not vector. Large rounded heads, tiny limbs, small dark oval eyes far apart, tiny noses, warmly expressive faces. All bodies fully visible including ears and tails. Same size and identity across every row. Moderate soft contact shadow only immediately under feet if desired. Isolated sprites on true alpha transparency; absolutely no checkerboard drawn into the pixels, no backdrop, no scenery, no panels, no labels, no text, no watermark, no existing franchise characters. Asset must be usable in Unity by slicing into 16 equal rectangular cells. Grid layout must be exact and orderly.

assets.name: propsPrompt
assets.prompt: Production game props sprite atlas, ONE square transparent PNG, exactly THREE equally spaced columns and FOUR equally spaced rows (12 cells), all isolated from one another with wide transparent padding. Every object centered inside its own cell, no object crosses a cell boundary, no text or labels. Premium soft hand-painted storybook gouache, warm paper-like fine texture, muted sage, cream, butter yellow, apricot, dusty turquoise, sweet rounded shapes, gentle lighting, same aesthetic as a refined preschool woodland garden. Row 1: a fluffy pale bluish-white rain cloud (no raindrops attached); a warm soft yellow sun with short rounded rays; a clear pale turquoise wind swirl with two little leaves. Row 2: one young green seedling in a small brown mound of earth; one complete blooming pink cosmos plant including stem and leaves in a small mound; one complete blooming butter-yellow daisy plant including stem and leaves in a small mound. Row 3: one large green leaf folded into a tiny boat with a little upright stem; one shiny red apple with tiny leaf; one golden pear with tiny leaf. Row 4: one small pastel pinwheel on a short wooden stick; one smooth pale stone stack of three pebbles; one tiny terracotta-capped friendly mushroom, no face. Objects fully visible, strong clean silhouettes, suitable for sprite-based 2.5D mobile game. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, no drawn checkerboard, no scenery, no border, no watermark. Use regular 3x4 grid with generous spacing. This is a sprite atlas asset, not a concept sheet or a UI mockup.
